decision: Versioned inference-only follow-up; preserve frozen main suite and original code/infer.py.
confirmed_problem: Original code/infer.py constructs an image row without sha256, but frozen cache adapter requires sha256. Reproduced KeyError on a registered training image.
resolution: Load complete registered row from fixed manifest, use identical frozen evaluation preprocessing and completed validation-selected checkpoint. Model receives image tensor only.
scope: No training, checkpoint selection, test predictions, labels, thresholds, splits or frozen settings changed.
